design.title: Design system
design.subtitle: Every NUSAQUEST component in every state. The first column is live; the other columns are forced on for review.

notes.buttons: One orange action per screen. A shelf under each button gives press depth; the face sinks when pressed.
notes.frames: Small radius top-left, 45° cut top-right, large radius bottom-right, square notch bottom-left.
notes.badges: Notched capsules for status and HUD labels.
notes.answers: Colour + symbol + letter + position. Colour floods the bar only when chosen or revealed; a miss is always slate, never red.
notes.symbols: Must stay distinct at 12 px and without colour, and never resemble a Latin letter or a UI icon.
notes.timer: Final five seconds: the ring breaks into five segments, the numeral pulses, screen readers are told.
notes.scoring: Numbers count up over 900 ms. Rank direction is shown by glyph and text, not colour alone.
notes.leaderboard: The top three sit on filled frames, even rows are mirrored, and your own row gets a yellow stroke.
notes.podium: Third rises first, then second, then first, followed by kawung confetti.
notes.roomCode: Six digits grouped 3 + 3. The QR is real and scannable.
notes.avatars: Geometric creatures seeded from the nickname. Abstract, never depictions of people.
notes.achievements: One eight-point star frame; glyphs built from parang, kawung, tumpal and tenun motifs.
notes.patterns: Texture at 4–10%, never content. The question screen is nearly pattern-free.
notes.celebration: Only for correct answers and the podium. Skipped under reduced motion.
notes.desk: Light theme for authoring: calm, sentence case, one primary action.
notes.type: Bricolage Grotesque for numerals and headings, Plus Jakarta Sans for the interface.
notes.color: Project tokens, not the official BINUS graphic standard. WCAG contrast is measured against the navy stage and kapas.
notes.motion: Four timing categories. Under prefers-reduced-motion everything becomes a short fade.
notes.sound: Short sound effects on every screen; adaptive music plays on the main screen only.
